entries.what: Rochelle sorts her book bag at the kitchen table, checks the van's check-engine light again and decides to keep ignoring it. She sets out the $40 parking permit and blue cooler bag for tomorrow's first day.
entries.outcome: Everything is packed by the door before bed.

entries.what: Walks the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for thirty minutes to loosen her back before the semester starts, then drops DeShawn at Flats High on its first day through the backed-up Vinca line.
entries.outcome: Back felt okay; drop-off took twice as long as usual.

entries.what: Evening index card session at the kitchen table after 9 p.m., writing color-banded cards for the skeletal system while the house is quiet.
entries.outcome: Finished about forty cards.

entries.what: First day at Tamsen Valley College: she parks in Lot C by 8:15 with her new permit, then sits through anatomy next to Linh and starts intro chemistry at 11. Aaliyah is on campus too.
entries.outcome: Survived day one and found her seats.

entries.what: Eats leftovers from the blue cooler bag in the car in Lot C between classes, back aching from the lecture seats.
entries.outcome: Stretched in the lot before chem.

entries.what: Drives her mother-in-law Loretta to a pharmacy stop mid-afternoon, then cooks dinner and reviews cards late.
entries.outcome: Got dinner on the table, cards done near ten.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 in the heat wave, with the lecture hall stuffy. At lunch she asks the assistant to compare two study apps, then cuts the long answer short and wants just one pick.
entries.outcome: Picked one app and moved on.

entries.what: Anatomy lab on Wednesday afternoon, then stops by Miriam's office hours room to look at the schedule. Heat makes the drive home slow with the van's windows down.
entries.outcome: Got through lab and noted the office hours time.

entries.what: Evening at home with fans running while Andre complains about the yard heat; she folds laundry with her hospital drama on.
entries.outcome: Early night.

entries.what: Chemistry at 11 and the campus bookstore afterward. She balks at the $160 lab manual, calls it seven and a half hours on the line, and asks whether an older edition works.
entries.outcome: Decided to hunt for a used older copy.

entries.what: Keisha calls on her dispatch break to nag about studying; Rochelle takes it in the Lot C car with the AC off to save gas.
entries.outcome: Promised to start reading ahead.

entries.what: Picks up groceries at Ruiz Family Market for meat and plans Sunday batch cooking, comparing prices carefully.
entries.outcome: Stayed under budget.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 on a heat-wave morning, Okoye pushing through slides. Rochelle asks a blunt question about the quiz format and Linh grins.
entries.outcome: Got a straight answer on quiz timing.

entries.what: Library cooling center after class, where she studies with her cracked-hinge laptop plugged in because the battery lasts forty minutes.
entries.outcome: Logged into the college portal and found the Canvas course pages.

entries.what: Family dinner with Andre, Aaliyah and DeShawn; Aaliyah teases her about studying beside her at the table.
entries.outcome: Everyone laughed; she did cards afterward.

entries.what: Saturday morning marsh boardwalk walk in the heat, short and early, then errands for the week.
entries.outcome: Back felt loose.

entries.what: Reviews the rent due Monday on the paper fridge calendar with Andre and counts checks to write for the landlord.
entries.outcome: Rent check ready for the 1st.

entries.what: Afternoon index cards on the cardiovascular system at the kitchen table while the heat breaks around fog time.
entries.outcome: Cards stacked by body system.

entries.what: Skips the Baptist service on Pell Road to do Sunday batch cooking: red beans and rice for the week.
entries.outcome: Five containers packed.

entries.what: Andre watches football and falls asleep by the second half while Rochelle folds laundry and reviews cards beside him.
entries.outcome: Quiet afternoon.

entries.what: Sets out the week on the fridge calendar with color pens for Loretta Tuesday, classes and DeShawn's practice.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out.
